description: Vietnam - Biomass Atlas is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Bioenergy, Extractive industries", published or maintained by World Bank Group. The GIS Biomass Atlas of Vietam is the final output from the biomass resource mapping component of the activity “ Renewable Energy Resource Mapping and Geospatial Planning – Vietnam” [Project ID: P145513]. You can find more information about the project here:. Coverage: Vietnam. It has 2 files in ZIP. The portal files it under Bioenergy, Extractive industries. The portal gives 2026 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
